title: About Google Verified badge - Local Services Help

facts.fact: Google is launching a single Google Verified badge for all Local Services Ads advertisers, replacing separate advertiser badges.
facts.quote: we're simplifying our advertiser badging by launching a single badge for all advertisers.

facts.fact: Existing Local Services Ads advertisers who have completed verification requirements will automatically earn the Google Verified badge and require no action.
facts.quote: all eligible existing advertisers who've completed verification requirements will automatically earn the new Google Verified badge

facts.fact: New Local Services Ads advertisers must successfully complete the Local Services screening and verification process to receive the Google Verified badge.
facts.quote: New advertisers will need to successfully complete the Local Services screening and verification process in order to get the Google Verified badge.

facts.fact: The Google Verified badge displays on the Local Services Ads profile and may appear on other Google surfaces where it adds consumer value.
facts.quote: will display on the Local Services Ads profile, and it may dynamically appear on other surfaces where it adds consumer value.

facts.fact: Local Services Ads ranking is not affected by the Google Verified badge change, according to Google.
facts.quote: Local Services Ads ranking won't be affected by this change.

facts.fact: Google is discontinuing the Money Back Guarantee associated with the Google Guarantee badge.
facts.quote: Google will be discontinuing the Money Back Guarantee associated with the Google Guarantee badge.

facts.fact: Eligible consumers can request reimbursement for Local Services Ads bookings made before the stated cutoff date.
facts.quote: services booked through Local Services Ads before December 7, 2025.

facts.fact: Reimbursement requests under the Google Guarantee must be submitted within 30 days of the initial service completion date.
facts.quote: Requests must be submitted within 30 days of the initial service completion date.
